title: Google News is just Forrest Gump's shrimp boat now
excerpt: You know that scene in Forrest Gump where Forrest sees Lieutenant Dan on the shore and is so distracted by him that he jumps off and swims to shore, allowing the boat to crash into the dock? ...
content_html:
You know that scene in Forrest Gump where Forrest sees Lieutenant Dan on the shore and is so distracted by him that he jumps off and swims to shore, allowing the boat to crash into the dock? 

Yeah, that's Google News now. In this metaphor, Forrest is Google and Lieutenant Dan is AI.

As a journalist, I have used Google News for many years to catch up on topics in which I am interested. I am always looking for news stories from U.S. news organizations published within a specific period of time, usually in the past week, but sometimes in the past day. 

Google News has a Tools menu, where you can specify the range. You can also specify the language and location of the publication. 

Bit by bit, all of this just stopped working. 

Now, when I do my traditional searches, a huge majority of some of my searches are from Instagram or other social media sites, not news publishing sites. 

Many of my results are in foreign languages I cannot even identify. 

Many of my results are published in foreign countries, not the U.S. as I specified. 

Now, the most recent failure is that when I specify news published in, say, the past week, it just ignores that setting and gives me news published weeks, months or years in the past. 

Google has abandoned Google News and let it crash into the dock.

content_html_zh:
你知道《阿甘正传》中的那个场景吗？阿甘在岸上看到丹中尉，他被他分散了注意力，于是他跳下船游到岸边，结果船撞到了码头？

是的，现在就是 Google 新闻。 在这个比喻中，福雷斯特是谷歌，丹中尉是人工智能。

作为一名记者，我多年来一直使用 Google 新闻来了解我感兴趣的话题。 我总是寻找美国新闻机构在特定时间段内发布的新闻报道，通常是在过去一周，但有时是在过去一天。

Google 新闻有一个工具菜单，您可以在其中指定范围。 您还可以指定出版物的语言和位置。

一点一点地，所有这一切都停止了。

现在，当我进行传统搜索时，绝大多数搜索来自 Instagram 或其他社交媒体网站，而不是新闻发布网站。

我的许多结果都是用我什至无法识别的外语写成的。

我的许多结果是在国外发表的，而不是我指定的美国。

现在，最近的失败是，当我指定过去一周发布的新闻时，它只是忽略该设置并为我提供过去几周、几个月或几年发布的新闻。

谷歌已经放弃了谷歌新闻并让它撞上了码头。
